title: Upload multiple reference images (e.g., 3 pictures of your characters) into…
content: Upload multiple reference images (e.g., 3 pictures of your characters) into Seedance 2.0 and prompt it to animate them performing a specific action together (e.g., playing in a rock band).
tips: Upload multiple reference images (e.g., 3 pictures of your characters) into Seedance 2.0 and prompt it to animate them performing a specific action together (e.g., playing in a rock band).

es.content: Sube múltiples imágenes de referencia (por ejemplo, 3 fotos de tus personajes) a Seedance 2.0 y prompt it to animate them performing a specific action together (e.g., playing in a rock band).

fr.content: Téléchargez plusieurs images de référence (par exemple, 3 photos de vos personnages) dans Seedance 2.0 et prompt it to animate them performing a specific action together (e.g., playing in a rock band).

ja.content: 複数の参照画像（例：キャラクターの3枚の写真）をSeedance 2.0にアップロードし、特定のアクションを一緒に行うアニメーションを作成するようにプロンプトを設定します（例：ロックバンドで演奏する）。

ko.content: 여러 개의 참조 이미지를 업로드하세요 (예: 캐릭터의 사진 3장) Seedance 2.0에 업로드하고 특정 동작을 함께 수행하는 애니메이션을 만들도록 프롬프트하세요 (예: 록 밴드에서 연주하기).

pt.content: Carregue várias imagens de referência (por exemplo, 3 fotos dos seus personagens) no Seedance 2.0 e prompt para animá-los realizando uma ação específica juntos (por exemplo, tocando em uma banda de rock).

zh.content: 将多张参考图像（例如，3张角色的图片）上传到Seedance 2.0，并prompt它们一起执行特定动作的动画（例如，在摇滚乐队中演奏）。
